findings.title: Framework ProcessEnv augmentation broke isolated configuration fixtures
findings.resolution: Readonly environment map; CI 34518817694 typecheck and configuration tests pass. Latest code must reverify.

findings.title: Source archive wrote into the directory being tarred
findings.resolution: git archive exact HEAD; subsequent CI artifacts generated successfully.

findings.title: Installed dependencies had material advisories
findings.introducedEvidence: Initial npm audit: six moderate and one high
findings.resolution: Upgrade Drizzle and Vitest; remove unused drizzle-kit chain. CI 34518817694 npm audit reports zero vulnerabilities. Not a guarantee of absence of unknown vulnerabilities.

findings.title: Unmerged planning PR contained uncaptured source/check granularity
findings.resolution: Preserve exact original bytes and cross-map all 38 sources/39 checks. Capture validator plus four negative tests passed. Current user authorization supersedes only the old no-development hold.

findings.title: Internal Next bind address caused valid browser requests to fail origin validation
findings.resolution: Validate browser Host or explicitly pinned APP_ORIGIN; retain negative cross-origin checks. Browser happy path passed at feafd8e.

findings.title: Impure render-time clock reads and effect helper failed React lint
findings.resolution: Lazy state plus expiry timer; asynchronous initialization callbacks. Lint passed at feafd8e.

findings.title: Small labels and primary-button state transitions reduced contrast
findings.introducedEvidence: Axe failures in CI 34518253402 and 34518817694, including a 4.49:1 transition frame
findings.resolution: Use readable muted token; solid dark hover; remove opacity transition between disabled/enabled. Preserve checks rather than relaxing thresholds.

findings.title: Missing model key could disable Explore despite manual fallback promise
findings.resolution: Access/session configuration can validate without model key; inference still fails closed. Regression passed at feafd8e.

findings.title: A saved approval followed by failed refresh could look like a failed write
findings.resolution: Retain saved decision outcome and show refresh-specific failure separately. Code inspection completed; browser approval flow passed.

findings.title: Proposal could bind to a newer deal than the context the model saw
findings.resolution: Pass observed deal version to proposal service, reject stale context before creation, and recheck again at approval. Added PostgreSQL regression.

findings.title: HTTPS proxy with HTTP internal URL could issue a non-Secure cookie
findings.resolution: Derive Secure flag from pinned public APP_ORIGIN; added regression.

findings.title: Production fixture mode permitted anonymous workspace provisioning
findings.resolution: Require demo access token in every production mode; browser tests exercise token sign-in. Controlled demo only, not full public abuse protection.

findings.title: Independent fresh review has not produced evidence
findings.resolution: Reviewer request attempted through GitHub; no actual independent review received yet. Do not self-approve or mark final gate passed.
